title: Fake Flight Change Call
scenario: A caller says your flight changed and asks for booking code plus card security code.

answers.A: Check inside the official app, booking, provider, or government site.
answers.B: Click/pay immediately to avoid losing the booking or offer.
answers.C: Forward it to a fellow traveller and ask what they think.
answers.D: Ignore/report the message and use a known contact route.

explanation: Fake Flight Change Call: the trap is to make money or value leave before the story is verified. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to click or follow the risky request.
proTip: Airlines do not need card security codes to discuss bookings.
